alt: Dark navy blue Steam Machine gaming PC cube sitting on a wood desk next to a monitor showing a colorful game, with two small decorative mushroom figurines beside it
story: The $1,049 Valve Steam Machine launched June 22, 2026 with '4K gaming at 60 FPS' prominently on its store page; after reviews showed most AAA games couldn't hit that target even on medium settings, Valve silently changed the claim to 'up to 4K gaming with FSR 4.1' on June 25.
why_funny: Valve spent years over-promising 4K 60fps performance and, when reviewers proved it wrong in real games, solved the controversy by just deleting the claim from the store page.
